messages:
eva: Noticing a short burst of GPU attach failures (~15%) in eu-west1-a. Traces look like repeated journal/fsync storms causing NVMe queue saturation on a few hosts. Anyone watching?

samir: I saw that. Affected hosts are gn-euw-a-11/12/14. dmesg shows lots of fsync latency then nvme queue stalls.

jules: paste of dmesg from gn-euw-a-12:
```
[ 45200.123456] EXT4-fs (nvme0n1p1): delayed allocation failed for inode 12345 at 0
[ 45200.123789] blk_mq_dispatch: queue 0 stuck, inflight 140
[ 45200.124000] nvme nvme0: I/O 3 timed out, aborting
[ 45200.124500] ext4_writepages: writeback returned -5
```

eva: root cause hypothesis: coordinated janitor + checkpoint jobs are hitting write-back path simultaneously. Overlayfs/overlay journal flush + small synchronous app writes are coalescing into large fsync waves. Drives hit queue depth and firmware starts timing out.

samir: mitigation plan (short): 1) reduce janitor/checkpoint concurrency in eu-west1-a to 1-2, 2) blacklist the three hosts in attach router for 30m, 3) lower vm.dirty_ratio and vm.dirty_background_ratio on those hosts to reduce burstiness.

jules: commands I'm applying now:
```
# cordon a host
kubectl cordon gn-euw-a-12
kubectl drain gn-euw-a-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=90
# tweak kernel params on affected hosts (via bootstrap script)
ssh gn-euw-a-11 'sudo sysctl -w vm.dirty_ratio=5 vm.dirty_background_ratio=2'
```

nora: I'll patch janitor configmap to set checkpoint_concurrency=1 for region eu-west1-a and add a short jitter to start times. Patch: kubectl -n ops patch configmap janitor --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/data/checkpoint_concurrency","value":"1"}]'

ops-bot: Router policy updated: blacklist gn-euw-a-11,gn-euw-a-12,gn-euw-a-14 -> fallback eu-west2 (canary 30m).

samir: additional short term: enable per-host blkio throttle qdisc for the janitor service to cap smallwrite IOPS to 2000 while we stabilize. Lower risk than cordoning more nodes.

eva: longer-term items: 1) run SMART long + non-destructive badblocks on the three hosts, 2) add a run to collect firmware reset counters and queue depth saturation stats, 3) consider changing overlayfs checkpoint strategy to stagger fsyncs or use async checkpoint where safe.

jules: I'm opening INC-4511 to track: include SMART runs, kernel param changes, drive health metrics, and janitor config PR.

nora: ops-note: cost tradeoff - increasing in-region hot spare to 4% reduces chance of attach storms affecting capacity. Recommend adding as a policy for eu-west regions. I'll add to the infra cost doc and tag finance.

samir: ops-runbook change: add auto-detect rule - if attach error rate >10% and >3 hosts show blk_mq queue stalls within 15m, automatically throttle janitor/checkpoint concurrency and apply attach-router blacklist for 30m. Will PR.

eva: status update: cordoned 1/3 hosts, janitor concurrency patched, router fallback live, per-host sysctl applied. Attach errors trending down. Leaving thread open for SMART results and postmortem notes.
